source.label: Marvel.com Marvel Universe wiki: Thing (Benjamin Grimm) (archived 6 July 2018)

powerOrigins.detail: Cosmic rays mutated him into a huge, rock-hided being of enormous strength and toughness on the Fantastic Four's first flight.

abilities.name: Rock-hide body
abilities.detail: A craggy orange hide over denser muscle, bone and organs, about 6 feet 6 and nearly 500 pounds. He does not age while in this form.

abilities.name: Superhuman strength
abilities.detail: Started around Class 5; years of training and further mutation pushed him to roughly Class 100, among the strongest beings on Earth.

abilities.name: Superhuman durability
abilities.detail: Takes Hulk punches, bazooka shells and point-blank gunfire without injury, and survived a planet-splitting blast from Galactus. Adamantium claws can still cut him.

abilities.name: Stamina and lungs
abilities.detail: Works at full effort for about an hour before fatigue sets in, and can hold his breath underwater for up to nine minutes.

abilities.name: Fast healing
abilities.detail: Recovers from severe injuries at an accelerated rate, though he cannot regrow lost organs or limbs.

abilities.name: Pilot and astronaut
abilities.detail: A former Air Force test pilot and astronaut who flew the Fantastic Four's ship, and once worked out an experimental Skrull craft in sixty seconds.

abilities.name: Brawler
abilities.detail: Fights with a loose style of his own built on boxing and college wrestling, sharpened long before he became the Thing.

feats.text: Stopped a multi-storey building of roughly 30,000 tons from toppling over, then lifted it back into place.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Fantastic Four Vol 1 95

feats.text: In a brawl across Central Park and Manhattan, he landed a blow strong enough to send the Hulk flying.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Fantastic Four Vol 1 112

feats.text: Defeated the Immortal Hulk, sent against him by the Puppet Master, seconds before turning human, breaking his arm and passing out for a week.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Fantastic Four Vol 6 13

feats.text: Threw a fuel truck at Galactus so Johnny could ignite it, setting the giant's torso and neck alight.

sources.label: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: The Fantastic Four: First Steps

feats.text: Hurled into space by Galactus and pulled back by Johnny, he slammed into Galactus's face and made him release Reed.

sources.label: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: The Fantastic Four: First Steps

feats.text: Charged through a building's support columns to bring it down, letting Sue push Galactus into range of the teleportation bridge.
